body.title: Feat/performance benchmarks
body.body: ## 🚀 OSCG'26 Contributor Notice **NexumDB participates in the Open Source Contributor Games 2026!** High-quality PRs earn you points, recognition, and networking opportunities. Please follow our [contribution guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for maximum impact and ensure your submission meets OSCG quality standards. ## Summary Introduced a comprehensive performance benchmarking suite using the `Criterion` framework. This PR establishes a baseline for comparing NexumDB's LSM-tree-based storage engine against SQLite and measures the current overhead of the AI-native execution layer.
